workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the three same-date completed Reading Notes and produced three bounded Research Objects. Q-20260907-01 concludes that individually safe workers do not establish system safety: the full origin-to-effect path needs preserved provenance, observable intervention, declared trust assumptions, alternate-path assessment, and recovery evidence. Q-20260907-02 concludes that visibility and whistleblowing are not enforcement authority: complaint intake, adjudication, sanction/remediation, and rule-change authority are separate institutional functions. Q-20260907-03 concludes that context is disposable but project truth is not: long-horizon engineering requires stable candidate identity, separate artifact and evidence state, independent acceptance, role re-admission, and freshness after change. All three objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, cover generation, Production staging, or Publication was performed.
